---
title: "Get set up"
---

You need two things: **R**, which does the calculations, and a place to type and run it. Choose one of the two options below.

## Option A: in your browser (recommended)

Nothing to install, and it works on any laptop with a web browser.

1. Go to [posit.cloud](https://posit.cloud) and create a free account.
2. Click **New Project**, then **New RStudio Project**.
3. In the panel called **Console**, paste this line and press Enter. It installs the packages the workshop uses, and takes a few minutes the first time:

```r
install.packages(c("readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "epifitter", "lme4"))
```

4. Download the two data files from [Data and credits](credits.qmd) and upload them using the **Upload** button in the **Files** panel. Put them in a folder called `data`.

## Option B: on your own computer

1. Install R from [cran.r-project.org](https://cran.r-project.org).
2. Install RStudio Desktop (free) from [posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/).
3. Open RStudio and run the same `install.packages(...)` line as in Option A.
4. Make a folder for the workshop with a `data` folder inside it, and save the two data files there.

## Check that it works

Paste this into the console. If it prints the number of fields in the survey, you are ready.

```r
library(readxl)
field <- read_excel("data/cassava_mosaic_survey.xlsx", sheet = "Field")
nrow(field)
```

It should print `512`.

## If you get stuck

Do not worry if something does not install the first time; it happens to everyone. Bring the error message to the first session, and we will fix it together in the first ten minutes.
